description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail or critically fail a Graft check performed on your own body.

Requirement You're one of the few names on the Butcher's list — granted automatically at 10th level, bio-attuned.

Immediately attempt the check again and take whichever result you prefer — Clean Take (§01) still applies to the reattempt. Being on the list is worth more than the reroll: the Butcher's restricted stock, the Wild tissue nobody else gets shown, is yours to ask after, no favor owed.
